To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) homeostasis is a special case of a more general model of allostasis that predicts physiological parameters and (ii) the homeostasis of a parameter is not its setpoint value but rather the value that minimizes its variance (error) and (iii) the homeostatic setpoint is the value that optimizes fitness under natural selection and (iv) the setpoint is the same for all individuals, but the variance of the parameter is optimized individually.

(1) the purpose of physiological control is to maintain allostasis, (2) allostasis is achieved through predictive regulation, (3) predictive regulation is optimal, and (4) optimal predictive regulation is achieved through optimal design.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how the body maintains stability and how it adapts to stress.
the design principles and mechanisms of physiological regulation.
how the brain predicts the body's demands and how the brain uses this information to control the body's physiology.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
homeostasis is not an adequate description of the regulation of physiological variables.
allostasis is the optimal design for physiological regulation.
homeostasis is a special case of allostasis in which the predicted demand is constant and the parameters are adjusted accordingly.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the homeostasis and allostasis models represent different views of how physiological regulation works, and that each has its own strengths and weaknesses.
the body is designed by evolution to meet demands.
the body's regulatory systems are not designed to maintain a constant value for each parameter.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the allostasis model is a much better predictor of physiological and pathological phenomena than is homeostasis.
allostasis provides a better model for physiological and medical science than homeostasis does.
allostasis is a more accurate model than homeostasis for understanding the design of physiological regulation and the pathophysiology and treatment of disease.
